title: Search From the Start: Search-Native Pretraining for Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.26809v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern language models (LMs) are increasingly deployed with access to search tools at inference. Yet pretraining remains predominantly focused on predicting static text, with search capabilities typically introduced during post-training. We propose Search-Native Pretraining as a practical route to teach search capability during pretraining from ordinary text corpora. Specifically, we augment pretraining corpus at scale with web-search queries and retrieve web response using a local index. Training on this augmented corpus teaches models to generate search calls and incorporate retrieved evidence during language modeling. Across Wikipedia and DCLM-Edu corpora and 360M to 3.3B parameter scales, search-pretrained models ("QueryLM") show improved performance on knowledge-intensive tasks and higher steerability toward the retrieved evidence. translated_title: 从一开始就学会搜索：面向语言模型的搜索原生预训练
translated_abstract: 现代语言模型（LM）越来越多地在推理阶段配备搜索工具进行部署。然而，预训练仍然主要聚焦于对静态文本的预测，搜索能力通常是在后训练阶段才被引入。我们提出“搜索原生预训练”作为一种实用路径，在预训练阶段就基于普通文本语料教会模型搜索能力。具体而言，我们大规模地用网络搜索查询来增强预训练语料，并使用本地索引检索网络响应。在这种增强语料上的训练使模型学会生成搜索调用，并在语言建模过程中融入检索到的证据。在Wikipedia和DCLM-Edu语料库以及360M至3.3B的参数规模上，搜索预训练模型在知识密集型任务上表现出更高的性能，并且对检索到的证据具有更强的可控性（可引导性）。关键的是，在对搜索预训练模型和常规模型进行监督微调之后，它们的优势依然得以保持。
tldr: 提出“搜索原生预训练”方法，通过大规模地将网络搜索查询及检索到的网页响应注入预训练语料，让语言模型在预训练阶段就学会发起搜索并利用检索证据，从而在知识密集型任务上取得更优性能，且该优势在监督微调后依然保持。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Search-Native Pretraining, which augments pretraining corpora at scale with web-search queries and retrieved web responses, teaching language models to generate search calls and incorporate retrieved evidence from the very start of pretraining, leading to improved knowledge-intensive task performance and greater steerability that persists after supervised fine-tuning.
